comment: Copy this file to config.json and customise for your environment
comment_cutoff: null = 30 days ago; set to YYYY-MM-DD to override

gerrit.comment_push: Set push_wip_draft=true to push the patch to Gerrit as a WIP change
gerrit.comment_remote: Git remote name to push to — change if your Gerrit remote is not named 'gerrit'

feedback.comment_feedback: Online feedback sources are disabled by default

notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and configure notifications.json in repo root

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes. rules_file is read-only (agents never write it).
